description: Cross-provider unified ranking. A reranker (LLM-as-reranker via qwen3:4b, swappable for a true cross-encoder later) fuses the heterogeneous shortlist into one comparable ranked list, replacing the Phase-4 by-provider grouping. Reranker unavailable => fall back to by-provider grouping + degraded flag.

requirements.title: Reranked unified list
requirements.description: The reranker scores the fused shortlist into one comparable ranked list across providers, behind a Reranker interface. rerank-on vs rerank-off MRR is reported on testdata/search_queries.json to justify its cost.

validation.notes: Rerank produces the expected ordering on a fixture shortlist.
rerank-on MRR is reported alongside rerank-off on the labeled set.

requirements.title: Reranker-down degradation
requirements.description: When the reranker is unavailable, the router falls back to by-provider grouping and sets a degraded flag in status/response — the query still succeeds.

validation.notes: With the reranker forced unavailable, Query returns grouped results and reranked=false + degraded=true.
